spreadTheWordlist.notes: Constructor-scored English wordlist by Brooke Husic and collaborators. Score floor 50 applied at corpus build. Attribution required; non-commercial use only; derived corpus JSON inherits the license.

usaTodayArchive.dataset: USA Today daily crosswords, 1995-2026, xd format (8,867 files)
usaTodayArchive.notes: sha256 is over the sorted list of per-file sha256s. All 15x15. 21 files rejected at parse (incomplete grids or duplicate answers). Raw archive is re-downloaded on demand (content/crosswords/data.txt keeps the URL); editions in content/crosswords/challenges carry solution and clues only, and the replay formula maps each date back to its archive original.

nytClueArchive.license: NYT content license held by site owner; clue text reproduced under that license
nytClueArchive.notes: 781,573 clues, 63,314 answers, 10,207 puzzles. Self-referential clues (cross-references, theme and circled-square mentions) filtered at import. Raw CSV and full lookup stay out of git; usage counts in nyt-usage.json.
